subfamily: tiki: the Zombie as Jeff Berry printed it (Oxford ZOMBIE pdf 2229), every part named, Don's Mix written out as grapefruit and cinnamon syrup; shaken, not blended, and poured over crushed ice (as the Codex's modern Zombie Punch, p. 127)
glass: tall Zombie glass (about 590 ml), filled with crushed ice
version: v0 (Tomás, round 3, 2026-10-01). Parts as Berry printed them; proportions mine: lime 22.5 -> 37.5, Don's Mix 15 -> 30 (20 grapefruit + 10 cinnamon syrup), falernum 15 -> 22.5, because his proportions shaken on paper run OUT on strength and acid (21%, 0.56%). Rums exactly his (45/45/30). Falernum made at home with no almond, nutmeg or ginger (veto-free). PENDING: Wren on the drink, its size and the grenadine; Hester on which Pernod.
